title: PM handoff mini-digest (Mar 12-13)
content:
2026-03-12 / evening — quick capture before I walk out

Purpose: compact handoff + TODOs for morning (fast read for on-call or backup PM). Not a full runbook, just the minimal context and priorities.

Top-line status:
- Launch window: on track for soft-launch Friday EOD if kernel perf test passes tomorrow morning.
- Biggest risk: quantized model latency regression at long prompts (seen in canary v2). Need fallback policy ready.

Morning checkpoints (priority order):
1) Kernel perf results (8:30am) — check infra metrics, if token p50 jumps >15% trigger rollback to v1.
   - Who: Samir (infra), cc: Riley
   - Where to check: Grafana -> redwood/prod/latency-kernel, canary dashboard link in ticket INFR-452.
2) PRD final edits for rollout notes (9:00am) — small updates only: add fallback decision matrix, add SLOs and rollback steps.
   - Responsible: me to push edits, Samir to validate technical wording.
3) Customer comms draft (10:00am) — short note for beta customers explaining possible short tail latency blips and mitigation steps.
   - Draft in doc: confluence:PRD-1729 (see section "Canary contingency")

Active TODOs (scratchpad format)
- [ ] Add explicit rollback command snippet to PRD (kubectl + canary tag) — small code block, 1-2 lines.
- [ ] Insert fallback model mapping table (v2-quant -> v1-fp16) and cost delta estimate.
- [ ] Ping legal about data retention wording for private deployments (quick ask to make sure our phrasing is okay).
- [ ] Quick run through with Solutions Eng (no more than 20 min) to align on expected customer questions.
- [ ] Confirm Dedicated autoscale threshold won't be hit during ramp (Riley to confirm).

Notes from today's syncs (choppy):
- PM sync with infra: kernel team saw edge-case latency when KV cache hot + sequence > 2k tokens; likely path issue in attention kernel (Samir will open PR).
- Support triage: 3 incoming threads flagged as "possible regression" — flagged for monitoring but not actioned yet (no customer impact reported).
- Growth asked for embedding baseline numbers to show cost-per-embedding after quantization; forwarded cost calc spreadsheet.

Stakeholder follow-ups (quick bullets)
- @Riley Chen: confirm autoscale test results -> slack thread #infra-canary  (link: slack://thread?ts=1700000000.000200)
- @Samir Patel: link to kernel PR + summary by 11am -> PR: https://github.com/redwood-inference/kernel/pull/412
- @Maya Ortiz (Solutions Eng): 20-min dry run tomorrow 11:30am — confirm invite sent.

Launch checklist snippets (for morning triage)
- Canary health: p95 latency, error rate, memory usage — green/amber/red; if any red, hold.
- Fallbacks: model mapping file present in config repo, automatic fallthrough enabled and smoke tests passing.
- Observability: tracing headers in place, sample rate 5% for initial window.
- Cost cap: billing threshold alarms configured for first 24 hours.
- Customer comms: support runbook + canned responses in Zendesk queue.

Quick edits I want to make to PRD tonight (keep short):
- Insert small table: "What to do if p50 increases" with 3 lines (investigate kernel -> revert -> notify customers)
- Add label for "data-sensitivity" for private deployments paragraph
- Reword sentence about "dedicated capacity burst" to remove ambiguous "short bursts ok" phrasing

Parking lot (non-urgent):
- Longer-term: add auto-experiment tool to measure quantization quality drift over time (not for this release).
- Post-launch: collect sample prompts for eval set and run A/B to check regressions after 1 week.

Quick links (scratch):
- PRD draft: confluence:PRD-1729
- Kernel issue ticket: INFR-452
- Cost calc sheet: https://docs.google.com/spreadsheets/d/1aBcDeFGhJk
- Kernel PR: https://github.com/redwood-inference/kernel/pull/412
- Slack threads: #pm-launch, #infra-canary

Two-minute prep before 8:30:
- Open canary dashboard, refresh metrics for last 24h, snapshot p50/p95 -> save screenshot if trend upward.
- Confirm Samir is online (ping) and Maya meeting invite exists.

Notes to self (voice):
- Keep comms calm and explicit. No "we're investigating" without ETA. If we hold launch, prepare one-line explainer + next steps.
- Lean on fallback; priority is availability over micro-optimizations for first 72h.

End of capture — come back in morning and clear tasks.

(quick draft bits — expect typos, this is a fast handoff note, not polished docs)
